content:
200 Returns details for the specified Tenable Web App Scanning plugin.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
plugin_id
required
integer
The ID of the plugin used to detect the vulnerability.
string
The name of the plugin.
string
The name of the plugin family.
string
Remediation information for the vulnerability targeted by the plugin.
string
An extended description of the vulnerability targeted by the plugin.
string
A short summary of the vulnerability targeted by the plugin.
string <date-time>
The publication date of the plugin.
string <date-time>
The date a patch was published to fix the vulnerability targeted by the
plugin.
string <date-time>
The date when Tenable last modified the plugin.
string
Enum: "info"
"low"
"medium"
"high"
"critical"
The risk factor associated with the plugin. Possible values are:
low
medium
high
critical. See the risk_factor  attribute in Tenable Plugin
Attributes.
Array of strings <uri> [ items <uri > ]
A reference link discussing the vulnerability targeted by the plugin,
typically a vendor security advisory or news article.
number
[ 0 .. 10 ]
The CVSSv3 base score for the vulnerability targeted by the plugin
(intrinsic and fundamental characteristics of a vulnerability that are
constant over time and user environments).
plugin_id
required
name
required
family
required
solution
description
required
synopsis
required
published
patch_published
plugin_modified
risk_factor
required
see_also
cvss3_base_score
Array of strings
The list of Web Application Security Consortium (WASC) category
associated with the vulnerability targeted by the plugin.
Array of strings
The Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) ID for the vulnerability
targeted by the plugin.
Array of objects
The Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) category for the
vulnerability targeted by the plugin.
400 Returned if your request specifies an invalid ID for a Tenable Web App Scanning plugin.

application/json
Array of objects [ items
non-empty
]
A list of reasons for the Tenable Web App Scanning error.
404 Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning cannot find the specified plugin.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of objects [ items
non-empty
]
A list of reasons for the Tenable Web App Scanning error.

see Rate Limiting.
